t: The Karcher WV 1 Compact Cordless Window Vacuum offers efficient, streak-free cleaning for windows, tiles, mirrors and other smooth surfaces, while effectively removing condensation. This versatile window cleaner is ideal for professional cleaners and tradespeople requiring fast, high-quality results on various surfaces. With its lightweight design, 25-minute battery runtime covering up to 70m², and 250mm working width, it delivers quick results. Its 360° Comfort!Clean design allows for convenient cleaning at any angle, even upside down, with zero dripping. The flexible silicone blade provides perfect edge cleaning. The 100ml dirty water tank is simple to empty hygienically, and the low battery LED indicator ensures timely recharging, delivering a consistently clean finish. The USB-C charging ensures quick readiness for the next job. The kit includes an indoor microfibre pad, a charger and a charging cable.
b: Can be used Upright, Horizontally & Upside Down
